label: GO step after an unrewarded trial
explanation: Fires only at the GO step (never D1 or D2), and almost only when the previous trial went unrewarded (prev_reward==0 holds 88% of the activation mass; it never fires when in_rew==1, i.e. at D2 after reward, and rarely at GO after reward). It fires on only about 35% of such steps, so precision is low (dev P=0.35, R=0.85, mass recall 0.88). Rate is higher early in the episode (falls from ~9% of steps in trials 0-9 to ~0.3% in trials 90-99), just after reversals (since_rev 2-4), after rare transitions and before switches (stay==0 2.4x lift), and when the value head is moderately high (7.7-8.1) but not at the highest values. Adding ep_trial<80 or a value window raises F1 only to ~0.54-0.55, so I kept the simpler predicate. No observed variable I tested explains which unrewarded GO steps it fires on. It may carry graded loss/uncertainty information in its magnitude, but I did not find a clear magnitude correlate.

scorecard.summary: Graded preference over last trial (GO: a2 S2 u, a1 S2 u, a1 S2 r) and trial before (GO: a1 S1 u, a2 S1 u, a2 S2 u); timing cues that raise it most: phase=GO, phase=GO & ep_dec=0, rel=-3.
